name: Love Will Tear Us Apart
source:
Drawing inspiration from Silent Hill and Kamitachi No Yoru.

As you prepare for a date with your girlfriend, reality itself is unraveling. Darkness and cruelty have become everyday norms. Amid such corruption, is there room for genuine love?

[From [url=https://hamezteam.itch.io/love-will-tear-us-apart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从《寂静岭》和《神立之夜》中汲取灵感。

当你准备与女友约会时，现实本身正在瓦解。黑暗和残酷已成为日常常态。在如此腐败的环境下，还有真爱的空间吗？
